policy: Only adopted territorial/municipal flags with recorded evidence. Unverified, proposed and unofficial designs are omitted. Municipal flags are not assigned to same-named counties or provinces.

omissions.romania: Unverified county-gallery designs, Harghita/Covasna contested designs, and city flags without verified adoption are excluded. Constanța city flag is not a county flag. Mureș must not inherit Maramureș artwork.
omissions.bulgaria: Municipal flags only; no invented province flags. Sofia is both a municipality and a capital province.
